Access to 5. For the purpose of preparing the electoral roll or
certain registers deciding any claim or objection to any electoral roll, the
Panchayat Electoral Registration Officer or any other person
authorised by him shall have the access to any register of
births and deaths as maintained by the Gram Panchayat or
to the admission register of any educational institution, and
it shall be the duty of every person in charge of any such
register to furnish to the said officer or person authorised
by him such information and such extracts from the said
register as may be required by them.
